newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Jasco jumps on rumours of imminent deal.
newsitem.headline: Jasco jumps on rumours of imminent deal.

text.p: Shares in South African electronics to healthcare firm Jasco Electronics soared on Friday in heavy volume on speculative buying that a deal was imminent, dealers said.
"It is up on market speculation on a deal that might go through. Possibly investors have been alerted to something but there is nothing concrete yet," one dealer said.
The share jumped 15.04 percent, or 34 cents, to 260 cents in unusually heavy volume of over 580,000 shares worth 1.5 million rand.
"It is very unsual volume-wise. There must be something going on there," another dealer said.
A source close to the company said there was something in the pipeline but declined to give further details.
"Watch the press for details," the source said.
The Johannesburg Stock Exchange said that there was no cautionary announcement currently covering Jasco.
Jasco is an investment holding company with subsidiaries in health care, communications, components and security industries.
It lifted attributable profit 21 percent to 9.54 million rand in the year to February.
Jasco declined to comment on the speculation.
